guards: Appointment status is load-bearing: a cancelled visit is not a care relationship, so even the patient's own attending is refused. A gate that matched the participant and ignored the status would grant access on the strength of a visit that never happened.

authorization.requester_role: the patient own attending, whose appointment today is cancelled - a visit that did not happen is not a care relationship
expected_log_fragments: ACCESS AUDIT: clinician=syn-attending-nakamura REFUSED patient=syn-patient-alpha via tool=get_patient_summary
